name: Acolyte
hook: You were raised in the Church of the Hearth. You have recited the Gift of the Flame a thousand times. Mother Aubrine wrote to you herself, asking you to come home to Emberwick.

name: Criminal
hook: You ran with the river smugglers once. Rook remembers you, and remembers that you still owe the Ash Market for a job that went wrong.

name: Folk Hero
hook: You stood up for Emberwick once, and the town still tells the story. Now the town is going hungry, and they're looking at you again.

name: Noble
hook: Your family is minor gentry that owes everything to the Marrowbys. Lady Celandine has asked you, personally, to make sure the adventurers don't upset the town's arrangements.

name: Sage
hook: You came to Emberwick to study the ember under the ford. You've noticed gaps in your own notes, in your own handwriting, about things you don't remember.

name: Soldier
hook: You served in the ford garrison under Dagna Holt. You were on the bridge the day the goblins took it, and you lived.

name: Outlander
hook: You weren't born in the Vale. You came over the Greywall as a child with no memory of the crossing, and you have always dreamed of a fire.

name: Entertainer
hook: You learned your trade from Lark, the last songkeeper, who taught you the Warden songs and then vanished.

name: Guild Artisan
hook: Tobin Fell taught you your craft at his ember-forge. His forge is going cold, and so is yours.

name: Hermit
hook: You lived alone for years on the burned bank near Old Maud, and never once used ember-fire. Your memory is the sharpest in the Vale.

name: Sailor
hook: You worked the river boats from Emberwick's docks. You've seen what moves at night under the Ash Market's lanterns.

name: Urchin
hook: You grew up on Emberwick's streets with Pip, and you look out for her. Lately she's been remembering things that frighten you both.
